    About Me

    I am a fourth year PhD candidate at University of Massachusetts, Amherst, working on reinforcement learning (RL). I have the fortune to work under Prof. Scott Niekum and to closely collaborate with Prof. Philip Thomas. My research focuses on designing algorithms for safe and efficient reinforcement learning (RL).

    Earlier, I spent time at Adobe (India) tackling novel machine learning challenges (2020-2023). Prior to that, I completed a BTech in Electrical Engineering from the Indian Institute of Technology (IIT) Madras (2016-2020).

    In my leisure time, I like to hang out with my friends, read books, write "something", and explore places. You can find my goodreads reading list here. I have also written a couple of blogs on topics that really intrigued me and here are some photos from recent trips.
